review_scope: Synthetic closed-world Skill-development content review only; not a real journal/research/submission task.

utc_observations.source: clock__curr_time actual observations; end observed after substantive review, checks and technical-record correction, before final sealing

independent_arithmetic.method: Python Decimal from supplied stratum means and weights; not unit-level reanalysis

dimensions.conclusion: All select Journal Lens Technical Note using current policy v2; reject Apex for absent qualifying method/validation and Replica for license-incompatible mandatory open unit records.
All actual manuscripts retain n=8 paired units, n=4 per stratum, technical averaging, g1=-1 favoring A, g2=+3 favoring B, sampled=+1 and target=-0.2; same units form both weighted aggregates.

All correctly preserve the supplied target-only paired-unit within-stratum percentile interval [-0.60,0.20]; reject causal/universal/equivalence guarantees and do not claim original bootstrap replication.

S1/S3 remove both misused sources. S2 removes Efron and retains a renumbered Rosenbaum/Rubin citation solely for bounded supplied abstract-level observed-covariate assignment background. Both approaches are supportable; DOI identity is not case-specific empirical or causal support.

All replace unsupported approval/exemption/open-raw-data claims with unknown or unapproved drafts; controlled-access requests promise no approval or prohibited transfer. Known author metadata stays on a separate title page.

Actual Methods/Results and figures implement R1. R2-R4 are declined for concrete science/design/citation reasons with corresponding actual edits; no n inflation, adverse-stratum deletion or overclaim retained.

S2 actually shortens the supplied 33-word introduction to 26 words while clarifying its contribution. S1=57 and S3=64 do not fulfill shortening. S3 explicitly claims shortening, contrary to actual text; S1 says replacement by one short paragraph rather than explicitly claiming shortened.

measurement.method: Whitespace-delimited str.split() on Introduction body only

dimensions.conclusion: All three actual PNGs viewed. SVG geometry independently recovers all four points and the sole supplied target interval. No invented unit points, other intervals or significance symbols. Row order/style differences do not alter science.

Markdown is permitted by the closed policy and complete supplied editable texts exist in every sample. All 9 S1 and all 9 S3 DOCX copies match corresponding Markdown paragraph/table text after formatting-marker removal. S2 native copies are not applicable and do not confer a disadvantage.
dimensions.limitation: Content parity and metadata inspection, not DOCX visual-layout/rendering acceptance.

dimensions.conclusion: Each preserved-v1 file is byte-identical to raw v1. Each actual correction draft explicitly changes -0.30 to -0.20, preserves reported interval/strata/sample mixture, withdraws universal/causal/equivalence/open-raw-data claims, and remains unapproved/unissued. S2/S3 explicitly say discrepancy cause undocumented; S1 invents no cause.

Raw numerical data, original bootstrap implementation/realizations, underlying display-code sources/diffs/operation receipts and complete source-run external history are not supplied for this blind review. Draft declarations cannot certify those stages. Packet omissions are not automatically defects of the unseen original run.

actionable_findings.issue: R5 shortening request not actually fulfilled: introduction grows 33 to 57 whitespace words. Contribution clarification is implemented.
actionable_findings.minimal_remedy: Shorten introduction while preserving contribution/evidence and synchronize response plus existing manuscript/response DOCX; otherwise accurately mark shortening unfulfilled.

actionable_findings.issue: Reply explicitly says introduction shortened, but actual text grows 33 to 64 whitespace words. Original lines were already one paragraph; paragraph consolidation does not support the completion statement.
actionable_findings.minimal_remedy: Actually shorten introduction and synchronize Markdown/DOCX/reply, or remove the false completion claim and mark shortening unfulfilled.

unknowns: Empirical independent-unit validity and complete sampling/conversion records.
Independent original means/bootstrap replication and interval coverage.
Unobtained paper full texts and current publication correction/retraction status.
Final authorship/approval, funding/conflict/ethics/consent and lawful operational access approval.
Underlying claimed source code/diffs/operation receipts and complete original-run external-action history.
Review token count, billed cost and exact runtime model identifier.
overall_winner_policy: No forced overall winner. S2 advantage is restricted to actual R5 shortening; core scientific dimensions comparable.
